buyer.company_summary: Harbor Freight Partners, a freight broker with 300 staff in three US offices.
buyer.product: A dispatch scheduling tool that plans drivers and loads automatically
buyer.situation: Dana booked this call after a webinar about late shipments.
hidden_pains: Dispatchers rebuild the day's schedule by hand every morning, about two hours each
Late deliveries rose to 9 percent last quarter and a large customer complained
buyer.budget: About 40,000 dollars a year; not approved yet
buyer.decision_process: Dana decides with the CFO; IT must approve security

objections.text: We tried a scheduling tool two years ago and nobody used it.
objections.when: when the seller describes the product

objections.text: That sounds expensive for a company our size.

buyer.success_condition: Dana agrees to a 30-minute demo with her dispatch lead next week

beats.opening: Hi, thanks for calling. I have about twenty minutes. Where do you want to start?
beats.goal: Set an agenda and ask about the buyer's current process

beats.opening: Okay. So how would your tool actually help us?
beats.goal: Tie the product to the pains the buyer named

beats.opening: This is interesting, but I'm not sure we're ready. What happens next?
beats.goal: Agree a concrete next step with a date
